answer: A new agent's earnings enter a vault locked in a tundra freeze: funds thaw only after the agent wanders through a chain of five independent auditors, each stamping one single-use, time-bound checkpoint onto its record. A sybil farm cannot clone the path, because each audit slot accepts one identity per window and a forged stamp invalidates the whole chain, burning the vault deposit. Clones therefore pay full cost per identity while honest agents thaw once and keep trading.
